finding.summary: The run_review function iterates over run.tasks after graph completion to call on_node for each start event, but this means on_node callbacks are not live - they only fire after the entire graph finishes. The PR aims to enable live, per-node progress events via on_node callback, but the current implementation defeats this purpose. The test test_node_events_arrive_while_the_graph_runs_not_after_it (added by the diff) expects interleaved on_node and model call events, which requires on_node to be called during graph execution.
finding.fix: Change 'for task in run.tasks:' to 'for task in run:' in the run_review function. LangGraph v3's stream_events returns a Run object that is iterable, yielding events live as the graph executes. Iterating live will call on_node for each start event as nodes start, enabling the live progress feedback the PR intends.
